preprocessing.spatial_description: crop to the bounding box of nonzero voxels, then resize that box to 128^3. Does NOT use the label: the box comes from image intensity only, so localization is not oracle.
preprocessing.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score before resize; unchanged by the crop because the crop removes only zero voxels
preprocessing.skull_stripping: not applied; BraTS 2024 volumes are already stripped
preprocessing.augmentation: NOT cached; applied per-epoch by the dataset
